==Dialogue==
{{Quest Description|Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
----
;{{Icon/Quest|Quests Interact}} Read Lucilla's WavesLine message
{{WavesLine|text = :'''Lucilla:''' Are you free tomorrow?
:{Choice} What's this about?
:'''Lucilla:''' I'll take that as a yes. My office, tomorrow morning at 8:00. It's right next to the Academic Affairs Office. Don't mix them up!}}
----
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 2 3 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 2 3 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (Lucilla's busy now. I should wait outside.)
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 2 1.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Not a problem. For project funding approvals, we can follow the New Federation model.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 2 2.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' But when it comes to picking research topics, I'm afraid I must insist on giving our teams more freedom to choose their own direction.
----
;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests}} Enter Lucilla's office
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 3 1.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' I have full confidence in our faculty and students....
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 3 2.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' ...Yes, precisely. But we both know that higher risks often yield higher returns...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 3 3.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' ...The Threnodian...? My apologies, but I'm not at liberty to reveal much about that.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 3 4.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' The Spacetrek Collective is preparing an investigation report with further details. Please be assured...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 3 5.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' ...Haha, you do have a keen sense of humor...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 4 1.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Yes, I understand...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 4 2.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' ...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 4 3.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Of course. I'll note it down and reply to you later...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 4 4.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' ...I see.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 4 5.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' ...
----
;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests Optional}} (Optional) Inspect photos
:A group is gathered around a plant in what appears to be a Pioneer Association office. You recognize Verina among them. A small note in the bottom right corner of the photo reads: ''Milestone achieved.''
:In the background, a lone figure remains at her desk, facing away from the camera. Could that be Lucilla?
:Students from various departments gather around Lucilla. She appears slightly overwhelmed. A small note in the bottom right corner of the photo reads: ''Graduation Group Shot.''
:A photo taken through a porthole that captures an enormous Soliskin.
:A small note in the bottom right corner of the photo reads: ''The largest Soliskin ever recorded!''
----
;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests}} Wait for Lucilla to finish her call
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 1.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Understood. Let's save those two issues for our call next week. The new partnership model is interesting, but I'll need to run it by my colleagues first.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 2.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Hehe, no, not at all. Why would I think you're making things difficult for us? The Academy has always been open to this kind of collaboration.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 3.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Okay then. See you next week. Have a wonderful day.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 4.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Tch—Hmph—Impudent little hamster! Really, using a crisis to haggle me down to wholesale?!
:{{DIcon}} Are you alright?
:{{DIcon}} I've never seen you this worked up.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 7.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' I'm fine.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 8.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Just had a bit of a tiff with a rather difficult partner. It's just that... Tch. You want some coffee?
:{{DIcon}} Only coffee for breakfast?
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 11.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Ah. Didn't realize the sun was already up.
:{{DIcon}} Do you always get up so early?
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 12.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' I haven't gotten any shut-eye yet. Didn't realize the sun was already up.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 13 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 13 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' So what's all this you've got going on, President Lucilla?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 14.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Right... what am I even working on? After the hero defeats the demon king, shouldn't we all be enjoying our "happily ever after"?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 15.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' But here I am, burning the midnight oil like I'm part of some sleep deprivation experiment. Hmph.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 16.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' A former colleague from the Pioneer Association taught me how to make this special coffee blend. Want a sip?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 17 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 17 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (Did she actually add...)
:{{DIcon}} This "coffee"...
:{{DIcon}} Has an "intoxicating" smell to it...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 20.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Oh, it's a favorite among the Goldrunners in the New Federation. Packs a punch. Heh, sometimes a little too much of a punch.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 21.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Ha... That hits the spot.
:{{DIcon}} (Ask about the photo of her student days.)
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 27.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' It wasn't the most thrilling time, but it certainly left me with some memorable moments.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 28.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Now I'm around students every day, but it's hard not to notice how far I've drifted from their world.
:{{DIcon}} (Ask about the Pioneer Association photo.)
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 29 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 29 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' I didn't know you worked with Verina before. She helped me out back in Jinzhou.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 30.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Oh! So that's where that girl went. Makes sense. The New Federation isn't the best place for a gifted Resonator like her in the long run.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 31.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Maybe I should invite her to the Academy... She could keep me company while I drown in overtime.
:{{DIcon}} I saw that group shot of you and the students.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 32 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 32 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' You look different now than you did in that photo.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 33.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Yes, I suppose I do—Ahem, I was a bit slimmer back then, wasn't I?
:{{DIcon}} What's the story behind that giant Soliskin photo?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 34.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Ah, that one. One of my students took it. Shame I never got to see that Soliskin with my own eyes.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 35.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Must be twice a person's height, at least from the picture. Can a Soliskin even grow that large?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 36 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 36 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Do you plan to tell me what I'm really doing here?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 37.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Alright, {{Rover}}. Technically, I shouldn't be asking a student this, so let's just call it a casual chat between friends.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 38.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' So, um, from a purely administrative standpoint... is there a chance that...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 39.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Certain "unverified intel" I share with you off the record could, through private channels, somehow influence an inspection report issued by a particular independent international organization?
:{{DIcon}} Huh?
:{{DIcon}} Can you please explain that in a way even a Fluffguin could understand?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 42.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Ahem. I mean... what's your network like at the Black Shores? Got any real pull there?
:{{DIcon}} Huh?
:{{DIcon}} Do you really want to know?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 45.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' I'll be straightforward, {{Rover}}. Startorch Academy has been in a bit of a bind ever since the Exostrider and Aleph-1 left Lahai-Roi.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 46.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' As you can see, our investors are reassessing the Academy's value now that the Exostrider is gone. They're holding a review next week to discuss new management policies moving forward.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 47.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Before that happens, I pulled some strings to get a third-party agency in for an independent investigation. Whatever they put in their report will steer the whole review.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 48 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 48 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' So you brought in the Black Shores to audit Startorch? When's this happening?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 49.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Dr. Luuk is waiting for the auditor at the Starward Riseway as we speak. They'll be here any minute.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 50.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Now, {{Rover}}, I'm not about to interfere with an independent audit. But I'd like you to be there during this visit. And if possible...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 51 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 51 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' You want me to put in a good word?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 52.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' No need. Just make sure they see the Academy for what it really is. My students can speak for themselves.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 53.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Dr. Luuk and the auditor have arrived. Shall we?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 54.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Oh, just a second.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 9 55.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Phew. Okay, let's go!
----
;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests}} Head to the station
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 10 1 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 10 1 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' I don't see anyone. Are they still on the way?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 10 2.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Hold on, Dr. Luuk says the auditor insisted on driving his own motorbike. That means they're on the second floor. Come on.
----
;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests}} Welcome the auditor
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 1.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Uh, what's all this?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 2.ogg}} '''Sigrika:''' Professor! We heard a very important visitor is coming to tour the Academy. Don't worry, we'll make a good impression!
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 3.ogg}} '''Lynae:''' Yep, we even threw together a little welcoming thing.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 4.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Oh, you rascals... Alright, but follow my lead. If this auditor is a by-the-book type, then we—
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 5.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Aha! WOOO!
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 6.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Oh yeah! What a ride! Now that was top-notch!
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 33.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' So... S-so many people?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 7.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' So not a confidential audit, huh?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 8.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Welcome to Startorch Academy. I'm Lucilla, the Academy President. So glad you could make it.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 9.ogg}} '''Students:''' WELCOME TO STARTORCH ACADEMY!
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 10.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Oh! Uh, right. I'm Aalto. Haha... You guys really know how to roll out the red carpet.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 11.ogg}} '''Sigrika:''' Nice to meet you, honored sir! I'm Sigrika, from the Preparatory Program. Thank you for coming to tour the Academy!
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 12.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Hello, hello! And please, just Aalto is fine. No need for that "honored sir" stuff...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 13.ogg}} '''Sigrika:''' Got it. I'm a Roya, you know! And I just want to say the Academy has been so wonderful to my people. We're all working together to make the world a better place!
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 14.ogg}} '''Sigrika:''' Oh! And there are lots of Roya students in Rabelle College too! Everyone works so hard!
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 15.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Uh? Huh...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 16.ogg}} '''Dorian:''' Chief Aalto! I'm Dorian from the Agronomy Wing! I've brought you a  Complete Nutrition Squeezy Jelly and our department's special self-heating Cup Noodles!
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 17.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Cup Noodles? Uh, thanks. And hey, just call me Aalto...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 18.ogg}} '''Misha:''' Director Aalto! I'm Misha from the Department of Exostrider Engineering! I couldn't bring my project here, so I'm here to sing instead!
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 19.ogg}} '''Nevin:''' Director, I'm from the Department of Voidmatters, sir! I can dance!
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 20.ogg}} '''Lynae:''' And I can do some custom mods on your bike!
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 21.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Mr. Aalto.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 22 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 22 f.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' This is {{Rover}} from Rabelle College. {{MC|m=He|f=She}} will be joining us for the duration of your tour.
:{{DIcon}} What's cooking, Director Aalto?
:{{DIcon}} It's an honor, Esteemed Auditor, sir.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 25.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' {{Rover}}! What a fantastic name! Not too long, not too short!
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 26.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Are we supposed to know each other or not?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 27 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 27 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' We are. But don't make it too obvious.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 28.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Copy that.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 29.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Well then, without further ado, let's head over to Rabelle College. I'll fill you in on our facilities along the way.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 30.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' That'll be great.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 31.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Tell those kids to go their separate ways. I'll meet you at Rabelle College.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 32 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 11 32 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Got it.
----
;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests}} Learn about the crisis from the students
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 1 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 1 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Someone want to tell me what's happening?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 2.ogg}} '''Lynae:''' You didn't know, {{Rover}}? Everyone's saying the board is looking to shut down Rabelle College.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 3.ogg}} '''Sigrika:''' No, not the college. Just the Synchronists. A professor covering our Royan History class told us the Spacetrek Collective wants them out of the Academy!
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 4.ogg}} '''Lynae:''' Yeah, well, the rumor mill says Rabelle eats up two-thirds of the Academy's budget, and the Collective's investors have strong opinions 'bout that.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 5.ogg}} '''Lynae:''' I say investors, but it's mostly New Federation money. Can't say I'm surprised they're pulling this kinda stunt.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 6 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 6 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' What about you, Chisa? What have you heard?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 7.ogg}} '''Chisa:''' Me? Actually, I don't know the specifics of what's happening. I just wanted to help...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 8 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 8 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (So it's all just hearsay for now...)
:{{DIcon}} Is this all happening because the Exostrider left?
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 12.ogg}} '''Lynae:''' Probably. I mean, they were literally picked just to pilot the Exostrider.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 13.ogg}} '''Sigrika:''' But Synchronists are all such brilliant students! Even if they can't pilot anymore, they still...
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 14.ogg}} '''Lynae:''' The New Fed only cares as long as you're an asset. The second you're not, you're out.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 15 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 15 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (There must be more to it than that.)
:{{DIcon}} Why didn't any of the Synchronists show up?
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 16.ogg}} '''Chisa:''' That's what's strange to me. But Professor Lucilla only had {{Rover}} come, so maybe it's not as serious as we think?
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 17.ogg}} '''Sigrika:''' Why do I feel like asking Senior to come means the opposite?
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 18.ogg}} '''Lynae:''' That Aalto guy... he's got a reputation in New Fed's circles. Known for handling intel, if you catch my drift.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 19.ogg}} '''Lynae:''' Isn't this supposed to be a cooperative visit...? Why's the Black Shores sending his type here?
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 20 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 20 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' (I'd better check the situation at Rabelle College.)
:{{DIcon}} I see. Thanks for filling me in.
::{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 21 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 21 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' The President and I are on it. You guys should head back for now.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 22.ogg}} '''Lynae:''' Hm, well... Gimme a shout if you need backup! There's no way I'm letting them do the Synchronists dirty like this!
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 23.ogg}} '''Sigrika:''' We're counting on you, Senior!
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 12 24.ogg}} '''Chisa:''' We trust you!
:{{DIcon}} (Head over now.)
:{{DIcon}} (Head over later.)

;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests}} Visit Rabelle College's classrooms
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 1.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' In addition to Augmented Resonance training, we place strong emphasis on general education for our Synchronists. This is Professor Mornye who teaches Synth Armament Studies.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 2.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Shall we sit in for a bit, Mr. Aalto? Before we tour the student projects?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 3.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' If it's no trouble?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 4.ogg}} '''Mornye:''' Alright. In the last lecture, we proved that the Ruehl Equation holds true for Type-II Synth Armaments. Today, we'll move on to their Tuning Stability Constants.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 5.ogg}} '''Mornye:''' Lixian, could you please write the final derivation from the last lecture on the board?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 6.ogg}} '''Lixian:''' Yes... Professor..
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 7.ogg}} '''Mornye:''' While she gets started, let's do a quick review. Waleo, what is the standard medium used to measure Tuning Stability in a lab setting?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 8.ogg}} '''Waleo:''' It's s-so... s-so... mmm...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 9.ogg}} '''Mornye:''' Yes, sodium. An interesting choice, though its volatility makes it impractical for standard testing.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 10.ogg}} '''Mornye:''' Sonia, could you tell me the standard medium for determining Tuning Stability in Synth Armaments under laboratory conditions?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 11.ogg}} '''Sonia:''' Mm... S-squ... Squeezy... Jelly...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 12.ogg}} '''Mornye:''' Squeezy Jelly, you say... Well, it seems we moved through the material a bit too quickly last time.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 13.ogg}} '''Mornye:''' But that's alright. Everyone, please refocus. Let's go over Lixian's board work—
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 14.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' As you can see, Mr. Aalto, this is our signature "Sleep Learning Program."
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 15.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Oooh! Very impressive! Ahem... How about we move on to the next stop?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 16.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' After you.
:{{DIcon}} Hang in there.
:{{DIcon}} I'll see you later.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 19.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Now we're about to show you some Augmented Resonance projects developed by our Synchronists.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 20.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Among them, the unmanned vehicle prototype shows exceptional promise across multiple market sectors—
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 21.ogg}} '''TARD-E Unit:''' Absent Students: 8. Data uploaded to cloud storage.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 13 22.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' These children... seem to have forgotten the importance of honoring their commitments.

:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 12.ogg}} '''Kamerel:''' Then per the agenda, I will now relay the investors' resolution following our previous inquiry.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 13.ogg}} '''Kamerel:''' Given that the loss of the Exostrider constitutes a de facto failure of the program, our immediate priority is to establish a compensation plan for the affected assets and students.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 14.ogg}} '''Kamerel:''' Furthermore, the Board directs that the Synchronist Program must be terminated immediately, or at minimum suspended.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 15.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' My stance remains unchanged, Ms. Kamerel. I intend to continue the program.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 16.ogg}} '''Kamerel:''' We require a justification.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 17.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Panelists, this is a theoretical prototype for a shield designed to counter Retroact Rain, created by one of our Synchronists.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 18.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' This prototype significantly accelerated the development of Jinzhou's own defenses. It saved countless lives during the war against the Threnodian Ovathrax.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 19.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' And yet, the material used in this prototype was originally nothing more than discarded scrap from one of the Engineering Department's experiments.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 20.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' It was only because its designer was a Synchronist—educated in engineering, Voidmatter, and even meteorology—that this material found a second life.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 21.ogg}} '''Kamerel:''' You seem to be arguing for the superiority of general education for the Synchronists, President Lucilla.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 22.ogg}} '''Kamerel:''' However, general education isn't even included in the program's White Paper. I fail to see a link between that and advancing the Synchronist Program.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 23.ogg}} '''Kamerel:''' The shield is an impressive surprise, but given the cost of gambling on such a slim probability, the cost-effectiveness is simply too low.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 24.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Ms. Kamerel. Panelists. How exactly are we meant to measure the cost-effectiveness of failure?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 25.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' As you can see, this shattered component comes from a failed experiment. One that was not even recorded in the Collective's official gazette.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 26.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' A Synchronist gave her life as the price for validating her theory.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 27.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Fifteen months later, this very component became the final piece for the construction of the Starward Riseway, the bridge between Lahai-Roi's earth and the sky.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 28.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Humanity does not always set out for the sake of victory, Ms. Kamerel.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 29.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Our Synchronists know from the day they enroll: No one knows when the Exostrider will awaken, and the odds that they'll be the one to pilot it are slim.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 30.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Yet they come anyway. They march toward likely failure from the very start.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 31.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' So I ask you, can you truly say that such failure has no value?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 32.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' And how can we call that a "failure" of the Synchronists, when the Exostrider was the one who banished Aleph-1 from our world?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 33.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Secretary Kamerel, the Black Shores representative requests the floor.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 34.ogg}} '''Kamerel:''' Proceed.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 35.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' On the subject of unforeseen benefits from the program, we find ourselves in agreement with President Lucilla.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 36.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' This is a set of disclosable data we've just compiled. A significant proportion of current Black Shore members came from Startorch Academy.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 37.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' These Bloom Bearers demonstrate exceptional capability, talent, and resolve—traits most prominent among the Synchronists.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 38.ogg}} '''Aalto:''' Furthermore, the Synchronists serve as role models for other students. I believe {{Rover}} is better suited to speak on that.
:{{DIcon}} Synchronists are a rallying banner.
:{{DIcon}} Synchronists are a living symbol.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 41 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 41 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' The Synchronist Program is a search for a way out for our civilization.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 42 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 42 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' When we believed the Exostrider was the only route, then those fit to pilot it were the Synchronists.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 43 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 43 f.ogg}} '''{{Rover}}:''' Now that the Exostrider is no longer a viable option, the ones fit to search for a new way out... Are still our Synchronists.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 44.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Yes, which is why I must disagree with evaluating the Synchronist Program purely in terms of cost-effectiveness. I urge investors to reconsider the criteria used to measure its value.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 45.ogg}} '''Kamerel:''' ...We require a discussion. This session is adjourned for five minutes.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 46.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' (Let them see your potential. Let them see your value.)
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 47.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' (But... that is not enough.)
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 48.ogg}} '''Kamerel:''' President Lucilla, following the review panel's deliberation: We fully recognize the potential value of the Synchronists as an independent academic division, as well as their role model effect. However—
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 49.ogg}} '''Kamerel:''' As {{Rover}} stated, only those fit to shoulder the burden of finding a new way out deserve the title "Synchronist."
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 50.ogg}} '''Kamerel:''' Therefore, we propose a compromise: Rabelle College will be preserved, but all future training must be subject to the guidance and review of this panel.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 56 51.ogg}} '''Kamerel:''' Let's "both take a step back," shall we, President Lucilla?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 57 1.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' This is it. The final fight, Lucilla.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 57 2.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Take a deep breath. Keep your composure. And ''remember''.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 57 3.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Everything you regret
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 57 4.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Everything that brings you joy
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 57 5.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Everything you have lost
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 57 6.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Everything you have witnessed
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 57 7.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' The answer you chase
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 57 8.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' The treasure you give everything to protect!
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 58 1.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' No, that won't be necessary, Secretary Kamerel.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 58 2.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' The Synchronists of today... They remain the closest thing this world has to a way out for our civilization.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 58 3.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' After our confrontation with Aleph-1, we recovered this audio recording from the interstellar probe "Farwatcher."
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 58 4.ogg}} '''Kamerel:''' It's nothing more than static.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 58 5.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Even so, it is the only legacy the pioneers of Solaris have left us—we are not alone, Secretary Kamerel.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 58 6.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Just as our ancestors took shelter in caves, just as Startorch Academy was built in Lahai-Roi, just as humanity itself endures on Solaris...
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 58 7.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' A brave soul took the first step to claim that future.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 58 8.ogg}} '''Kamerel:''' I fail to see what this has to do with the Synchronists.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 58 9.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Using Rabelle College research, we can build vehicles driven entirely by Augmented Resonance. That means complete immunity to frequency interference.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 58 10.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' And the training our Synchronists undergo makes them the perfect pilots for these vessels.
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 58 11.ogg}} '''Kamerel:''' But the Stridergate has been sealed. Not to mention, whatever lies beyond can hardly be called a "route."
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 58 12.ogg}} '''Lucilla:''' Who said civilization's route to the future has to go "down"?
:{{A|Vo main lahairoi wmxztk 58 13.ogg}} '''Lixian:''' The stars.
